gui.guhs.safari.rit.vol: The truck is full, chonk! The next one is coming soon.
gui.guhs.safari.rit.instappen: All aboard! Sneak = get off. Your own guhs run happily alongside the truck.
gui.guhs.safari.kabel.onderweg: The gondola is on its way. Wait on the platform!
gui.guhs.safari.kabel.instappen: All aboard! Enjoy the view. You can only get off in a station.
gui.guhs.safari.kabel.blijf_zitten: Stay seated, chonk! It's very high up here.
gui.guhs.safari.kano.rit: Off we go! The canoe paddles itself up the river and back.
gui.guhs.safari.kano.vrij: Your own canoe! W/S paddle, A/D steer. Sneak = get out.
gui.guhs.safari.race.uitleg: Ostrich race: %s laps around the hay bales! W = run, A/D = steer, space = jump.
gui.guhs.safari.race.finish_top: Finish! Your time: %s. You're number %s on the scoreboard! Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.race.gestopt: The race has stopped. Your ostrich walks back to the start.
gui.guhs.safari.moment.voeder_nu: Feeding time for %s has started! (%s) Now even the shy animals come out.
gui.guhs.safari.moment.praatje_straks: In 1 minute: ranger talk at the truck stop of %s!
gui.guhs.safari.moment.praatje_nu: The ranger talk at the stop of %s begins! Keep listening for a few Safari Coins.
gui.guhs.safari.moment.nacht_straks: Tonight there's a night safari! The lantern trucks leave soon.
gui.guhs.safari.moment.nacht_nu: The night safari has begun! Hop into a lantern truck and look for glowing eyes.
gui.guhs.safari.moment.jarig: Today it's the %s's birthday! Photos of the birthday animal earn double Safari Coins. Hip hip hooray!
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.bedankt: [Ranger Guh] Thanks for listening, chonk! Here are some Safari Coins.
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.bedankt_vol: [Ranger Guh] Thanks for listening! (You've earned enough coins from talks today.)
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.hoi: [Ranger Guh] Hi! Shh, not so loud, or the animals get scared. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.schema.praatje: Ranger talk at the stop of %s
gui.guhs.safari.schema.jarig: Birthday today: the %s! (double coins for its photos)
commands.guhs.safari.ritten: Route %s blocks, %s stops, %s trucks · canoe %s · cable car %s · race track %s · birthday: %s · night safari now: %s
gui.guhs.safari.feit.entree.0: Welcome aboard the safari truck! Arms and paws inside the truck, chonk.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.entree.1: In the petting corner live a goat, an alpaca, a guinea pig and a donkey. They love cuddles.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.entree.2: The timetable board by the square shows when it's feeding time. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.entree.3: Every animal in this park is as sweet as a guh. Well, almost.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.savanne.0: Lions sleep up to 20 hours a day. We call that a chonky lion.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.savanne.1: A giraffe has as many neck bones as you: seven! Just a lot longer.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.savanne.2: Meerkats take turns standing guard. Look: one is always standing up!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.savanne.3: Every zebra has its own stripe pattern, just like your fingerprint.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.delta.0: Hippos can't swim: they just walk along the bottom. Super chonky.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.delta.1: Flamingos are pink because of what they eat. If you eat lots of cheese, do you turn yellow?
gui.guhs.safari.feit.delta.2: A capybara is the most relaxed rodent in the world. Anyone may sit on its back.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.delta.3: The manatee is related to the elephant. Really, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.regenwoud.0: A sloth only goes to the toilet once a week. Now that's taking it easy.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.regenwoud.1: The okapi looks like a zebra but is related to the giraffe. Very shy!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.regenwoud.2: Orangutans build a new bed of leaves in the tree every evening.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.regenwoud.3: Glow worms live behind the waterfall. They make their own light, like night lights.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.bamboe.0: A giant panda eats bamboo up to 12 hours a day. A real snack guh.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.bamboe.1: Red pandas use their thick tail as a blanket when it's cold.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.bamboe.2: Gibbons swing from branch to branch so fast it looks like they fly.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.bamboe.3: In the mist of the bamboo mountains you can hear the pandas munching. Listen!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.ijskust.0: Penguins can't fly, but they swim super fast. And slide on their bellies!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.ijskust.1: Under its white fur a polar bear is actually black. Funny, right?
gui.guhs.safari.feit.ijskust.2: Seals can close their nostrils under water.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.ijskust.3: If you're lucky you'll see the northern lights here at night. And maybe the narwhal...
gui.guhs.safari.feit.oertijd.0: Mammoths lived long ago, but here they're just staying for a while.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.oertijd.1: The sabre-toothed tiger has long teeth, but mostly uses them to smile.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.oertijd.2: In the warm springs the mammoths take a nice hot bath.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.oertijd.3: A woolly rhino wears its own winter coat. Always!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.europa.0: Beavers build dams from branches and mud. Real master builders!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.europa.1: A hedgehog has about 5000 spines. Don't pet it the wrong way!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.europa.2: Otters hold paws while they sleep, so they don't drift apart.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.europa.3: A badger lives in a sett with lots of little rooms. Cosy!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.australie.0: A kangaroo can't walk backwards. Only hop forwards!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.australie.1: Koalas sleep up to 18 hours a day. Almost as much as a chonky guh.
gui.guhs.safari.feit.australie.2: Wombat poop is square. Really, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.feit.australie.3: The quokka is the happiest animal in the world. It's always smiling!
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.goed: Well done, vahoeg! +%s Safari coins for the clever one.
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.goed_vol: Well done! (Your quiz pot for today is already full, njeg.)
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.fout: Njeg, too bad! The right answer was: %s
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.te_laat: That question is over. There will be a new one at the next stop!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.instappen: All aboard! Look down through the glass bottom. You can get off at any jetty.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.onderweg: The glass-bottom boat is out on the water. Wait at the jetty, the next one comes soon!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.blijf_zitten: Stay seated, njeg! Or you'll get soaking wet.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.terug: Back at the jetty! You can get off here. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.delta.0: Look down! Those are the hippos. They can stay under water for 5 minutes.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.delta.1: Hippos don't really swim: they bounce along the bottom. Hop, hop!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.delta.2: See that manatee? It eats 50 kilos of water plants a day. Vads!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.ijskust.0: There, under the glass: penguins! Under water they almost fly, that fast.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.ijskust.1: The narwhal feels with its long tooth how cold and salty the water is. Clever, eh?
gui.guhs.safari.boot.ijskust.2: Penguins sometimes give each other a pretty pebble as a present. Njeg, how sweet!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.halte: %s jetty! You can get on and off here. Or just stay seated.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.savanne.0: The savanna is coming up! Watch the zebras coming to drink. Slurp, slurp!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.savanne.1: The lion family is sunbathing on Pride Rock. Don't wave too hard, they're asleep.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.savanne.2: An elephant drinks up to 200 litres of water a day. That's a lot of guh cups!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.regenwoud.0: The rainforest! Hear the monkeys? They're shouting at the boat. Njeg, what a racket!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.regenwoud.1: Below us fish swim between the tree roots. Look through the glass!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.regenwoud.2: It rains almost every day in the rainforest. Good thing the jetty has a roof.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.europa.0: We're sailing into the European Forest. The beavers build their dams here. Gnaw, gnaw!
gui.guhs.safari.boot.europa.1: See that fox between the trees? It's just as curious as a guh.
gui.guhs.safari.boot.europa.2: Beavers can stay under water for 15 minutes. Longer than the skipper!
gui.guhs.safari.fm.aan: ♪ Safari FM ♪ The park's own station! Wiggle along in the truck.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.0: Grandpa Cheeseguh's cheese nibbles: now with extra holes! The holes are free.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.1: Sand in your fur? Try Vads Shampoo! Now with the scent of wet zebra.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.2: Found: one pair of penguin sunglasses. It does look very cool now.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.3: Come to the Ostrich Race! Winners get eternal glory, losers just a little bit.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.4: Out of coins? Answer the quiz questions in the truck! The guide knows everything. Well, almost.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.5: New in the gift shop: a cuddly hippo that snores just as loud as the real one!
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.6: The weather: sunny on the savanna, snow on the ice coast and vahoeg everywhere.
gui.guhs.safari.fm.reclame.7: This was Safari FM. Don't forget to wave at the giraffe. It (almost) waves back!
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.entree.0.vraag: What is this safari park called?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.entree.1.vraag: What must you NOT do near the animals?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.entree.2.vraag: How do you ride through the park?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.savanne.0.vraag: What is the biggest land animal?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.savanne.1.vraag: Why does a zebra have stripes?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.savanne.2.vraag: How long is a giraffe's neck, roughly?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.delta.0.vraag: Where do hippos like to be during the day?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.delta.2.vraag: How does a crocodile cool down?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.delta.2.goed: It lies with its mouth open
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.regenwoud.2.vraag: Why is a poison dart frog so brightly coloured?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.regenwoud.2.goed: As a warning: don't eat me!
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.regenwoud.2.fout2: It just came from the hairdresser
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.bamboe.0.vraag: What does a giant panda eat almost all day?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.bamboe.1.vraag: How many hours a day does a panda eat, roughly?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.bamboe.2.vraag: What colour is a red panda?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.0.goed: No, but they swim really well
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.1.vraag: What is a narwhal's long 'horn' really?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.2.vraag: Why doesn't a polar bear feel cold?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.2.goed: A thick layer of fat and a warm coat
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.ijskust.2.fout2: It always sits by the stove
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.oertijd.0.vraag: How did a mammoth stay warm?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.oertijd.1.vraag: What did a mammoth use its tusks for?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.oertijd.1.goed: To push snow aside and find food
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.oertijd.2.vraag: Which ice age animal had very long fangs?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.europa.2.vraag: How do otters stay together while they sleep?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.australie.0.vraag: Where does a kangaroo carry her baby?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.australie.2.vraag: How far can a kangaroo jump in one leap?
gui.guhs.safari.quiz.australie.2.fout2: All the way to the moon
